lines.zh: 六条腿一起动，比我说话快。
lines.en: Six legs move together, faster than I can talk.

lines.zh: 我沿着气味走，一步不差。
lines.en: I follow the scent trail, never off by a step.

lines.zh: 触角碰一下地面，路就清楚了。
lines.en: One touch of my antennae and the path is clear.
This soil is loose; my feet sink in.
The line goes this way; I'll join it.

lines.zh: 我扛着东西，走得像斜的。
lines.en: Carrying a load, I walk crooked.

lines.zh: 前面的同伴敲了敲地面。
lines.en: The one ahead taps the ground.

lines.zh: 绕过那颗石子，别浪费力气。
lines.en: Go around that pebble; don't waste effort.

lines.zh: 我的路线会留给后面的。
lines.en: My route is left for those behind.
I move the grains of soil aside, one by one.
Grass shadows sway above; I keep walking.
My steps are small, but I never stop.
I climb the slope upward without panting.

lines.zh: 这条道我们走了很多年。
lines.en: We've walked this road for many years.

lines.zh: 我沿着同伴留下的气味走。
lines.en: I follow the scent my nestmates left.
The slope is too steep, so I switch paths.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸出来，慢慢转。
lines.en: I extend my antennae and turn them slowly.
The nest is warm; the soil smells damp.
I count the nestmates coming and going.

lines.zh: 有颗卵被搬到深处去了。
lines.en: An egg has been carried deeper in.
Wait a moment; let me groom my legs.

lines.zh: 地下很暗，但我们认得路。
lines.en: It's dark below, but we know the way.

lines.zh: 我用前足擦脸，擦了很久。
lines.en: I wipe my face with my forelegs for a long while.
This grain of sand is bigger than I am.
Wind outside brings in a little dust.

lines.zh: 蚁丘里安静，只有沙沙声。
lines.en: The anthill is quiet, only a rustling.

lines.zh: 我的腹下一亮，是晒到了光。
lines.en: A gleam under my abdomen; I found sunlight.
A short rest; there's still a long way to go.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，挡住了我的路。
lines.en: You crouched down and blocked my path.

lines.zh: 你的指缝里有糖的味道。
lines.en: There's sugar in the creases of your fingers.
To look at you, I don't need to look up.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比我的巢还高。
lines.en: Your boot is taller than my nest.

lines.zh: 你也在数我们有多少只？
lines.en: Are you counting how many of us there are?

lines.zh: 别踩，这里每一步都有同伴。
lines.en: Don't step; nestmates are under every step.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的蚁丘的气味。
lines.en: You carry the scent of another anthill.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，凉了一截。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and everything cools.
I raise my head and reach toward you with my antennae.

lines.zh: 你带的这东西，我们能搬动。
lines.en: That thing you carry — we could move it.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿折了，还能走。
lines.en: One of my legs is bent, but I can still walk.

lines.zh: 这一下，对你不算什么吧。
lines.en: That blow was nothing to you, I suppose.
I wasn't crushed — lucky.
My shell cracked a little; no harm.
I was flung out and landed on my back.

lines.zh: 你打到的只是我的背甲。
lines.en: You only hit my back plate.
The nestmates smelled it; they'll come.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，等这一下过去。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and wait for it to pass.

lines.zh: 疼得我触角都垂下来了。
lines.en: It hurts so much my antennae droop.
Still moving, so I can still carry.
That crumb — give it here.
Sweet — it's sweet, I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你放在地上就行，我们搬。
lines.en: Just set it on the ground; we'll carry it.
This could feed the whole nest two days.
Don't hold it high; I can't climb there.

lines.zh: 我的触角已经贴到它了。
lines.en: My antennae are already touching it.

lines.zh: 分我半粒，我带你去看蚁丘。
lines.en: Share half a grain, and I'll show you the anthill.

lines.zh: 那味道顺着风过来，真浓。
lines.en: The smell comes on the wind, so strong.
I can carry it; don't underestimate me.

lines.zh: 你留着大半，我们只要一点。
lines.en: Keep most of it; we only want a little.
Don't step there; there's a tunnel beneath.

lines.zh: 你碰了一下，我的队列乱了。
lines.en: One nudge from you and my column broke.

lines.zh: 我太小，你根本没看见我。
lines.en: I'm too small; you never saw me.
Knock me aside; those behind will fill in.

lines.zh: 让我从你鞋底下面过去。
lines.en: Let me pass under your boot.
You're sitting on the anthill.
We don't give way; we go around.
That footfall caved in half the soil.
You stepped on my carrying line.

lines.zh: 退一步，我扛的东西不能掉。
lines.en: One step back; my load can't fall.

lines.zh: 你腹部的颜色和我一样。
lines.en: Your abdomen is the same color as mine.
Come back to the nest with me; the way is wide.

lines.zh: 我们的气味不用再分了。
lines.en: We needn't keep our scents apart.
Three taps of the antennae means yes.
Did you carry that big grain too?

lines.zh: 慢慢走，别撞到后面的队伍。
lines.en: Walk slowly; don't bump the line behind us.
The nest will keep a chamber for us.
There are three old scars on your legs.
We'll guard this entrance together.

lines.zh: 泥土会记住我们的味道。
lines.en: The soil will remember our scent.
I bite down and swing it onto my back.
This grain weighs three times what I do.
Don't grab it; I found it first.
Whatever falls to the ground counts as a resource.

lines.zh: 我搬得歪，可我不会撒手。
lines.en: I carry it crooked, but I won't let go.

lines.zh: 这个能换巢里的一点位置。
lines.en: This earns me a little more room in the nest.
I brace it with my forelegs — steady now.
I haul it all the way back without resting.
Who dropped this? It belongs to the nest now.
There's soil on it; I'll lick it clean.

lines.zh: 那边有东西碎了，声音很脆。
lines.en: Something broke over there — a crisp sound.
One with the wrong abdomen color.
A scent is coming from another nest.

lines.zh: 那块木头在松，我能啃开。
lines.en: That wood is loosening; I can gnaw through it.
The target is right of the entrance, close.

lines.zh: 地面在动，是有东西埋着。
lines.en: The ground moves; something is buried there.
A nestmate taps twice — a warning.

lines.zh: 有陌生的脚踩进了领地。
lines.en: Strange feet have stepped into our territory.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，触角全张开了。
lines.en: I raise my head, antennae fully spread.

lines.zh: 那片土被翻过，痕迹很新。
lines.en: That soil was turned over; the marks are fresh.
Ahead there's sweetness — and danger too.
I've picked it out: that one there.

lines.zh: 我张开上颚，很小，但够用。
lines.en: I open my mandibles — small, but enough.

lines.zh: 你退到巢口了，那是死路。
lines.en: You've backed to the nest mouth; that's a dead end.
Three of us go at once — spread out.
The more I look, the more wrong that color is.
I crawl low; the wind can't carry me off.

lines.zh: 前面的同伴让开了，让我过。
lines.en: The nestmates ahead step aside and let me through.
It wants to run, but soil keeps footprints.
I've already got its leg in my mandibles.
Don't get distracted; keep your eyes on that one.
It steps back once; I step forward twice.
The nest is behind me; I can't give ground.
Almost there; my antennae are trembling.
My mandibles snap shut — just once.
I clamp its joint and hold on.
I climb onto its back, then bite.

lines.zh: 这一口，是替整个巢咬的。
lines.en: This bite is for the whole nest.

lines.zh: 它比我大，可我们比它多。
lines.en: It's bigger, but there are more of us.
I tear off a small piece, then retreat.
Bite from the side; that's the softest part.
It throws me off; I climb back up.
I grip and don't let go, legs braced tight.
That bite didn't pierce; again.

lines.zh: 我从蚁蛹里钻出来，浑身发软。
lines.en: I chew out of the pupa, soft all over.

lines.zh: 巢里那一格，刚好容下我。
lines.en: The chamber in the nest fits me exactly.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是舔干净触角。
lines.en: My first act is to clean my antennae.
The soil outside is still cold.

lines.zh: 几只同伴围过来，碰了碰我。
lines.en: A few nestmates gather and touch me.

lines.zh: 我认得了这条气味的路。
lines.en: I've learned this scent-marked road.
The anthill's mouth faces east, out of the wind.
I shake my back and shed the pupa shell.

lines.zh: 从今天起，我搬这一条线。
lines.en: From today I carry along this line.
The nest has one more of us now.
Too hot; my legs are trembling.

lines.zh: 从这么高掉下来，壳都震了。
lines.en: Falling from that height rattled my shell.

lines.zh: 水漫进来，我抓紧一根草。
lines.en: Water seeps in; I cling to a blade of grass.

lines.zh: 气浪把我和土一起掀了。
lines.en: The blast threw me up with the soil.

lines.zh: 那支箭钉在我旁边的土里。
lines.en: That arrow pinned the soil beside me.

lines.zh: 有什么在我壳上爬，甩不掉。
lines.en: Something crawls on my shell and won't shake off.
The nest has no food left; I'll go find some.

lines.zh: 雷打在地上，整座蚁丘都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning hit the ground; the whole anthill shook.

lines.zh: 掉出世界了，连气味都没有。
lines.en: Falling out of the world, with not even a scent.
